items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I think there’s been racial issues regarding Wynton Marsalis and his groups of guys

ctx.x: There seems to be very few black musicians playing this well — especially Dixieland. Probably down in New Orleans and so forth, but when you go to some of the festivals that have a lot of the Dixieland bands, it’s turned more into, well it’s changed. They have the costumes and all that.

Yeah I don’t know how to answer that question and I think there’s been racial issues regarding Wynton Marsalis and his groups of guys, and I think — I don’t know if he’s been misquoted or not but there was times when people got the impression that he was maybe prejudiced, but I don’t think he necessarily is. I think since these things have become hot topics, I think he’s made a point of having more white people in his bands and stuff like that, and this is just my take on it, I don’t know. It’s kind of an icky…
It is. It doesn’t have a good answer, and it could be an answer we don’t want to hear too.
